ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 55:45 ratio of high-intensity (white/light-grey) to low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: The left lobe features a large, contiguous high-intensity white region with dark pixel clusters along the trailing edge. The right lobe exhibits a predominantly low-intensity dark field populated with discrete, high-intensity circular white clusters and a larger irregular white patch in the upper-medial quadrant.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central depression with an estimated interior angle of 50 degrees; notch depth occupies approximately 15% of the visible fluke's vertical height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations present along the entire continuous trailing edge; peak amplitude is highest at the distal lobe tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral convex upward curvature originating from the median notch and terminating at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous localized, roughly circular high-contrast white pixel clusters (5-12 pixels in diameter) scattered across the low-intensity dark field of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, non-parallel light-colored linear pixel disruptions visible on the mid-to-inner section of the right lobe, oriented roughly horizontal to the fluke's axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive circular scarring consistent with barnacle colonization on the right lobe; secondary linear scarring (rake marks) observed near the right side of the median notch.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant pigmentation asymmetry between the predominantly white left lobe and the predominantly dark right lobe.
